description: "The following represents the framework for the most comprehensive and ambitious anti-corruption bill to have ever been proposed in the State of Indiana. It is a work-in-process and Constitutional challenges are expected, especially in its current form. Future work will address the Constitutional risks and defend the Constitutionality of this framework before it is finalized…
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Joshua Brant
title: Indiana Anti‑Corruption and Government Accountability Act – Elect Joshua Brant
